content_fields.title: Test that the host's network namespace is not shared (Docker)
content_fields.description: Declare an explicit user-defined network so the container never inherits host or default namespace settings.
content_fields.finding: The service definition relies on default networking with no explicit network mode declared or pinned.
content_fields.current_code:
web:
    build: .
    command: bash -c "alembic upgrade head && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8091 --workers 1 --reload"
    volumes:
      - ./app/:/app/
    ports:
      - 8091:8091
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
services:
  web:
    networks: [frontend, backend]
  db:
    networks: [backend]

networks:
  frontend:
  backend:
    internal: true
criteria: Services attach to declared networks and the database network is internal.
